drifted.spec_text: FlushManager provides background flush with timer + dirty threshold; US6 acceptance: supports configurable timer interval AND dirty-count threshold.
drifted.actual: FlushConfig::dirty_threshold (default 100) is configurable but NEVER read by the worker loop (src/flush.rs:172-208). Flushes fire only on the timer interval (when dirty_count>0) or on explicit trigger_flush(). put()/delete() do not signal the manager on crossing a threshold. flush_manager_dirty_threshold_triggers passes via its 50ms timer, not threshold logic. Threshold trigger effectively unimplemented; config field inert. Missed by prior sweeps.

drifted.actual: tests/integration_ssd.rs obtains durability/startup via inherent/internal APIs (initialize_from_client, snapshot_entries, flush::flush_to_disk, mark_flushed, load_entries); put/get/delete/iterate_all do use the interface. FR-05 now enables force_flush()-based durability.

drifted.spec_text: Capacity exhaustion surfaced to the caller as CapacityExhausted (variant defined at interfaces/src/iextended_metadata_store.rs:12).
